title: Make the most of the new moon on Dec. 8 and get closer views of the stars with the Celestron Inspire 100AZ
summary: The Celestron Inspire 100AZ is a great first telescope and will give you better views of the stars and Saturn in the moonless skies come Dec. 8. It is now 15% cheaper for Black Friday.
contentText:
The new moon on Dec. 8 is the perfect time to stargaze at targets that might otherwise be shrouded by moonlight, allowing clearer views of stars, star clusters and some deep-sky objects. The Celestron Inspire 100AZ is an affordable entry point into manual astronomy, now even cheaper for Black Friday . We gave it 4/5 stars in our Celestron Inspire 100AZ review for its sharp planetary and lunar performance, along with a handy smartphone adaptor for basic photographs of your view.

You can get the Celestron Inspire 100AZ refractor telescope on sale right now on Amazon for $323.

Save on our best budget telescope pick. It has a 3.94-inch aperture and comes with a couple of eyepieces for different levels of magnification.

It is a great option for lunar viewing and getting better views of brighter objects in the night sky, like individual stars or planets. We did manage to see the Andromeda galaxy (M31) with it in our full Celestron Inspire 100AZ review , where we gave it 4/5 stars. View Deal

Jamie Carter Telescopes are fairly expensive, so it is quite rare to find an instrument that still performs at a lower price point. Often these are older models from trusted brands, like the Celestron Inspire 100AZ , a basic 4-inch refractor that gets you closer to your favorite night sky objects without paying top dollar for it.

It is a great budget telescope for those who want to make a first purchase without spending thousands. The alt-azimuth mount will help build confidence in aiming at the night sky and practical astronomy. While smart telescopes require almost no astronomy knowledge to operate, this model suits the stargazer who prefers to get hands-on with observation. It also has a smartphone holder for capturing quick snaps of a nice view during your session.

With the new moon on Dec. 8, this will be the perfect tool for getting views of dimmer objects that might otherwise be washed out by moonlight. This might be particular stars or even deep-sky objects like star clusters and some galaxies. We saw the Andromeda galaxy (M31 ), the moon and Saturn with it during our testing, so we know that you can get views of famous night sky objects. With Saturn high in the south-eastern sky this December, it will be a great opportunity to test the Inspire 100AZ on planets and later in the month, the moon.

This deal brings the price of the Inspire 100AZ down to $323 and while it isn't the lowest ever price for this telescope, it is still a good $57 saving on a potential holiday gift.
